nodes.label: cTrader Quote Bridge
nodes.summary: Supplies executable Bid/Ask observations; absence remains distinct from market closure.

architecture.ownership: The bridge owns source observations.
architecture.boundary: External quote process to append-only runtime inputs.
architecture.bounded_work: One current quote and bounded candle append per cycle.
architecture.failure_isolation: Missing or stale quotes fail the decision closed without fabricating prices.

nodes.label: Business Runtime
nodes.summary: Runs bounded collection and decision cycles independently of the Control Plane.

architecture.ownership: Runtime launcher and canonical runtime package.
architecture.boundary: Windows process group; never the Stable release authority.
architecture.bounded_work: One bounded cycle per scheduled tick.
architecture.failure_isolation: Control Plane installation preserves this revision and process.

nodes.label: Decision Owner
nodes.summary: Produces Long, Short, or Wait on the fixed clock from point-in-time inputs.

architecture.ownership: xauusd_forecaster.decision.
architecture.boundary: Pure selection and inference behind runtime composition.
architecture.bounded_work: One decision across the fixed action set.
architecture.failure_isolation: Unavailable inputs produce Wait or an explicit failed cycle.

nodes.label: Evidence Ledger
nodes.summary: Preserves immutable predictions, matured outcomes, and append-only audit evidence.

architecture.ownership: Evidence schema and ledger owner.
architecture.boundary: Append-only SQLite records exposed through bounded readers.
architecture.bounded_work: One immutable record or bounded page.
architecture.incremental: Stable record keys and append cursors.
architecture.failure_isolation: Write failure remains visible and cannot rewrite historical decisions.

nodes.label: Model Generation
nodes.summary: Builds one complete challenger generation from a bounded matured materialization.

architecture.ownership: Training generation, materialization, ridge, and runtime owners.
architecture.boundary: Optional background training; no partial generation activation.
architecture.bounded_work: Bounded eligible slice per materialization cycle.
architecture.incremental: Maturity cutoff, generation ID, and checkpoint.
architecture.failure_isolation: Last verified active generation remains in service.

nodes.label: News Collector Runtime
nodes.summary: Collects bounded point-in-time publication evidence independently of decisions.

architecture.ownership: News collection package and collector entry point.
architecture.boundary: Optional Windows process with explicit heartbeat.
architecture.critical_path: Optional input; cannot block the decision clock.
architecture.bounded_work: Bounded sources and records per poll.
architecture.failure_isolation: Source and collector failures remain local and visible.

nodes.label: News and Semantic Owners
nodes.summary: Qualifies event identity, relevance, annotation, storylines, and bounded retrieval.

architecture.ownership: Concrete collection, semantics, annotation, retrieval, brief, and scheduler packages.
architecture.boundary: Package owners; the news namespace is not a mutable facade.
architecture.bounded_work: Bounded event batches and retrieval pages.
architecture.incremental: Publication/receipt clocks, event identity, and scheduler checkpoint.
architecture.failure_isolation: Provider or source failure preserves valid prior evidence and explicit unavailable states.

nodes.label: Metered AI Gateway
nodes.summary: Applies capacity and provenance rules to optional provider work.

architecture.ownership: Canonical AI package.
architecture.boundary: Metered external provider calls behind queued work.
architecture.critical_path: Optional and never required for the request path.
architecture.bounded_work: One bounded task with declared token and retry limits.
architecture.failure_isolation: Capacity or provider failure stays in the optional queue.

nodes.label: Dashboard Read Owners
nodes.summary: Builds bounded status, market, news, learning, and operational projections.

architecture.ownership: Concrete Dashboard resource and health owners.
architecture.boundary: Read-only projection package outside transport and UI.
architecture.critical_path: Status core is bounded; growing resources are optional.
architecture.bounded_work: Fixed status payloads and bounded resource pages.
architecture.failure_isolation: Last-good bounded snapshots remain explicit as stale.

nodes.label: Local Dashboard API
nodes.summary: Serves bounded local operator resources without owning domain state.

architecture.ownership: Thin API entry point plus dashboard owners.
architecture.boundary: Loopback request boundary.
architecture.critical_path: Core status is critical and bounded independently.
architecture.bounded_work: One fixed response or bounded cursor page.
architecture.failure_isolation: Optional resource failure does not expand the critical status path.

nodes.label: Dashboard Sync
nodes.summary: Transports bounded materialized resources to Cloudflare with independent cursors.

architecture.ownership: Dashboard sync protocols, progress, and transport.
architecture.boundary: Windows-to-Cloudflare transport process.
architecture.critical_path: Optional transport, independent of Business Runtime.
architecture.bounded_work: Bounded batch and serialized byte ceiling per resource.
architecture.failure_isolation: One resource failure cannot erase last-good remote state.

nodes.label: Cloudflare D1 Read Store
nodes.summary: Stores bounded remote dashboard resources and exact paged history.

architecture.ownership: Worker D1 schema and adapters.
architecture.boundary: Cloudflare persistence behind Worker handlers.
architecture.bounded_work: Bounded query/page and transaction.
architecture.failure_isolation: Local runtime continues; Web reports unavailable rather than fabricating data.

nodes.label: Worker / Browser
nodes.summary: Renders public decision support plus Access-protected Admin surfaces.

architecture.ownership: Web app, worker, and route owners.
architecture.boundary: Cloudflare-only deployment plane; Admin remains behind Access.
architecture.bounded_work: One bounded request and lazily loaded view chunk.
architecture.incremental: Immutable build SHA and resource cursors.
architecture.failure_isolation: Private tools do not add public APIs or mutate runtime state.

nodes.label: Control Plane
nodes.summary: Stages and verifies exact revisions without taking ownership of Business Runtime state.

architecture.ownership: Installer, watchdog, and verified bundle state.
architecture.boundary: Separate Windows identity from Business Runtime.
architecture.critical_path: Critical only for release control, not live decisions.
architecture.bounded_work: One exact-revision installation transaction.
architecture.incremental: Installed bundle revision and immutable evidence.
architecture.failure_isolation: Rollback restores the prior verified bundle and preserves Business Runtime.

nodes.label: Control Center
nodes.summary: Supervises runtime and executes structured release transactions from an exact verified bundle.

architecture.ownership: Stable entry plus runtime, release, and presentation owners.
architecture.boundary: Local operator control; Stable changes require explicit Promote or Reverse.
architecture.bounded_work: One operation with deterministic structured result.
architecture.incremental: Candidate/Stable revision, result schema, and immutable history.
architecture.failure_isolation: Indeterminate evidence fails closed; post-render WPF failures stay in WPF.

nodes.label: Assistant
nodes.owner: Retained Assistant package and private Web surface
nodes.summary: Private retained surface; local worker, indexing, and compaction remain paused.

architecture.ownership: Assistant package and private Admin view.
architecture.boundary: Access-protected and isolated from decision execution.
architecture.bounded_work: No local background work while paused.
architecture.failure_isolation: Cannot affect decision, release, or public request paths.

nodes.label: Private Architecture Explorer
nodes.owner: Architecture manifest and private Admin UI
nodes.summary: Build-time, exact-SHA architecture navigation with no runtime architecture API.

architecture.ownership: architecture/manifest.json is the single GUI source.
architecture.boundary: Build-time loader to a lazy Access-protected chunk.
architecture.bounded_work: One manifest under the fixed byte limit.
architecture.incremental: Schema version and immutable build SHA.
architecture.failure_isolation: Malformed manifest fails the build; public initial navigation remains unchanged.

nodes.label: GitHub Repository
nodes.summary: Provides immutable source revisions and validation evidence, not deployment authority.

architecture.ownership: GitHub repository.
architecture.boundary: Source and CI only; no GitHub Deployments or Environments.
architecture.bounded_work: One exact revision and bounded API retry.
architecture.incremental: Commit SHA and check run ID.
architecture.failure_isolation: Retryable transport failures are bounded; deterministic provenance errors fail closed.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Version Control
nodes.summary: Uploads immutable Versions; Stable traffic moves only through explicit local Control Center operations.

architecture.ownership: Cloudflare Workers version plane.
architecture.boundary: Only deployment plane for Web and Worker.
architecture.critical_path: Critical for release, not local decisions.
architecture.bounded_work: One immutable version upload or explicit traffic operation.
architecture.failure_isolation: Push and PR movement never change Stable traffic.

nodes.label: Latest-main Integration
nodes.summary: Rebuilt the stack on the audited latest main; it remains pending until merge.

architecture.ownership: Stack base and execution tracker.
architecture.boundary: Documentation and semantic rebase boundary.
architecture.bounded_work: One verified linear rebase.
architecture.failure_isolation: No merge or deployment during reconstruction.

nodes.label: Phase C — Owner Extraction
nodes.summary: Extracts Dashboard, News runtime, and Control Center owner boundaries.

architecture.ownership: One owner boundary per stacked PR.
architecture.boundary: Behavior-preserving owner extraction.
architecture.bounded_work: One PR boundary at a time.
architecture.failure_isolation: Failures repair at the lowest owning PR.

nodes.label: Phase D — Canonical Packages
nodes.summary: Moves Decision, Evidence, Training, News, AI, Assistant, Runtime, and Dashboard to canonical packages.

architecture.ownership: Canonical package owners.
architecture.boundary: Package dependency direction.
architecture.bounded_work: One package family per PR.
architecture.incremental: Migration map and exact parent/head SHA.
architecture.failure_isolation: Compatibility shims stay thin and non-owning.

nodes.label: Phase E — Test Organization
nodes.summary: Organizes all current-main and campaign tests by owner with zero unexplained loss.

architecture.ownership: Test and workflow contracts.
architecture.boundary: Validation-only organization.
architecture.bounded_work: One complete normalized test inventory.
architecture.incremental: Pytest node ID and exact head SHA.
architecture.failure_isolation: Windows-only suites remain explicitly routed.

nodes.label: Campaign Closure
nodes.summary: Documentation-only final handover after Explorer validation.

architecture.ownership: Closure audit and ordered handover.
architecture.boundary: Documentation only.
architecture.bounded_work: One exact-head audit.
architecture.incremental: Final stack SHAs and check runs.
architecture.failure_isolation: Cannot merge, deploy, or alter production state.

nodes.label: Training Materialization
nodes.summary: Turns only matured evidence into a bounded, checkpointed training slice.

architecture.ownership: The training materialization owner selects eligible matured rows.
architecture.boundary: Optional background thread outside the decision clock.
architecture.critical_path: Background only; current decisions never wait for it.
architecture.bounded_work: One bounded eligible slice per checkpoint.
architecture.failure_isolation: Failure preserves the last valid materialization and active model.

nodes.label: Published Model
nodes.summary: Represents the complete, verified model generation available to Decision.

architecture.ownership: The generation handover owns the published complete model set.
architecture.boundary: Immutable generation artifact read by Decision.
architecture.critical_path: Decision reads the last valid published generation.
architecture.bounded_work: One complete generation set per handover.
architecture.failure_isolation: A failed challenger never replaces the last valid model.

nodes.label: Candidate Validation
nodes.summary: Validates one exact candidate revision before any Stable traffic decision.

architecture.ownership: Control Center release transactions own candidate validation.
architecture.boundary: Local explicit release transaction.
architecture.bounded_work: One exact candidate and finite validation result.
architecture.incremental: Candidate SHA, version ID, and validation evidence.
architecture.failure_isolation: An indeterminate candidate fails closed without moving Stable.

nodes.label: Manual Stable Promotion
nodes.summary: Moves Stable only through an explicit local Promote or Reverse operation.

architecture.ownership: The local Control Center operator owns Stable traffic changes.
architecture.boundary: Explicit control-plane action; branch movement is never authority.
architecture.bounded_work: One explicit Promote or Reverse transaction.
architecture.incremental: Stable version ID and immutable operation result.
architecture.failure_isolation: Failure leaves prior Stable traffic unchanged.

scenarios.label: Follow one Decision
scenarios.description: Trace one quote through the fixed decision clock, immutable evidence, and remote read-only projection.

steps.message: The current executable Bid/Ask arrives.
The bounded fixed-clock cycle begins.
Decision produces Long, Short, or Wait.
The immutable decision record is appended.
A bounded read model is materialized.
The local read-only resource is served.
A cursor-bounded batch is transported.
The remote projection mirror is updated.
Worker / Browser presents the read-only result.

scenarios.label: How Training feeds Decision
scenarios.description: Training is background work; Decision keeps using the last valid published generation.

steps.message: Only matured evidence is eligible.
A bounded training slice is checkpointed.
One complete challenger generation is built.
Only a verified complete generation is published.
Decision reads the last valid published model and never waits for training.

scenarios.label: Cloudflare is unavailable
scenarios.description: Remote presentation is affected; local Decision and Evidence continue.

steps.message: The last explicit Stable selection remains evidence.
Cloudflare presentation is unavailable.
Web presentation cannot serve the remote projection.

scenarios.label: Release path
scenarios.description: Preview is not Stable; the Control Plane never owns Business Runtime evidence.

steps.message: Start from one exact validated revision.
Install and verify the exact bundle.
Open an explicit local release transaction.
Validate the candidate without moving Stable.
An operator explicitly promotes or reverses Stable.

continues.message: Decision using the last valid model CONTINUES.
